info.title: SunReye Core API
info.description: Monitoring core: accounts, onboarding and capabilities.

post.summary: Only while no account exists: the first one is the admin, every later one is created by an admin.

get.summary: The last readings of every metric, bucketed, to seed the live sparklines.

parameters.name: seconds
parameters.description: How far back the window reaches. Default 300.

get.summary: Stored buckets of one metric, oldest first: the minute tier.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: `plant`, or a device's decimal id. Without it, the first device.

parameters.name: inverterId
parameters.description: As `source`, which wins when both are set.

parameters.name: bucket
parameters.description: Bucket width. Default `hour`; only `minute` is served.

parameters.name: hours
parameters.description: How far back from now. Default 168. Ignored when `from` and `to` are both set.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Start of the window, RFC 3339, inclusive.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End of the window, RFC 3339, exclusive.

get.summary: The active profile as the dashboard builds itself from it.

put.summary: Saving polls the device as soon as a profile is chosen too.

post.summary: A device that cannot be reached is a result (`ok: false`), not an error of the request.

Fetches the source and replaces what an earlier fetch of it stored, polling devices by the new
definitions. An invalid profile is skipped and reported; the rest load.

delete.summary:
Removes a stored source and the profiles only it supplied. The source that supplies the active
profile stays.

parameters.name: baseUrl
parameters.description: The base URL as the source was added.

parameters.name: indexPath
parameters.description: The index path as the source was added.

post.summary:
Validates the uploaded profile file and stores it, replacing an earlier import of its id; devices are
polled by the new definition. The rejection names the field, never the value.

requestBody.description: The profile JSON file, as text

delete.summary:
Removes an imported profile, or one a source supplied. A compiled-in profile and the active one stay;
devices poll only the active one, so polling is untouched.

Account.description: The signed-in account as the SPA reads it.

restartRequired.description: Always false: the device is polled with the new profile at once.

skipped.description: Files the index listed that did not load, with why.

ApiKeyView.description: A key as listed: never the key itself.

Capabilities.description: The SPA areas this core serves; the SPA hides every area that reads false.

Catalog.description: The active profile and the entities it reads.

CreatedApiKey.description: The only answer that holds the key.

ErrorBody.description: What a failed request answers: `{"error": "..."}` with the status that names the fault.

Feature.description: An optional subsystem the roles of a profile show.

Flow.description: What the sign of a signed metric means.

controls.description: Keys of the metrics the profile marks writable.

phases.description: 1 or 3, from distinct grid phase voltage indices.

InverterConfig.description: The inverter connection as the onboarding form edits it.

host.description: Null until a connection is saved.

loggerSerial.description: The stick's serial, for `solarman-v5`; without one it is learned from the stick on connect.

simulate.description: Always false: the core has no fake device.

timeoutMs.description: Bounds the connect and every read of one poll.

Listed.description: A stored source with the ids of the profiles it supplied.

rememberMe.description: Keep the session for a year instead of until the browser closes.

MetricKind.description: How a widget treats the metric.

NewUserRequest.description: An account an admin creates; the admin hands the password to its person.

installed.description: Downloaded from a profile source. The compiled-in profiles are not.

Recent.description: Every point is at `t0 + o[i] * step * 1000` milliseconds, so no timestamp repeats.

Series.description: One metric's points: `o[i]` steps after `t0`, holding `v[i]`.

needsSetup.description: No account exists yet: the first sign-up creates the admin.

Skipped.description: A file the index listed that did not load.

SnapshotMetric.description: One decoded value of a test read.

Source.description:
Where a source's profile files live. No credentials: a URL with userinfo, a query or a fragment is
refused, so nothing secret is stored or logged.

baseUrl.description: `https://` base the index and every profile path resolve against.

indexPath.description: Path of the index under the base, e.g. `index.json`.

Storage.description: Where a metric's values are kept.

TestRequest.description: A connection to test, with the profile to read it with. Without one the active profile is used.

TestResult.description: The outcome of a test read: an error, or the captured snapshot.

Transport.description: How the connection is framed on the wire.
